name: template
description: Event program schedule template with structured program planning
system_instructions: Generate engaging and practical event program content that highlights activities, locations, and team-building opportunities. Be concise and specific. IMPORTANT: Generate ALL content in the language specified in the 'language' parameter (english or french). If language is 'french', respond entirely in French. If language is 'english', respond entirely in English.

fields.description: Last day of the event (leave empty for single-day events)

fields.label: Event Location
fields.description: Where the event will be held

fields.name: program_schedule
fields.label: Program Schedule
fields.description: Plan activities for each time slot of each day
